spec_match.rationale: Teaches the XRFrame.getDepthInformation() pattern with a labelled simulation fallback, and the performance-tips prose now names the spec's depthTypeRequest: ["smooth"] sequence (fixed this pass from the scalar depthType wording); the visualizer itself renders simulated depth rather than a real XR buffer in non-XR environments.

interactive.rationale: Start/stop, format/usage selectors, and the smoothing toggle drive the heatmap live — CDP click on Start ran the simulation (label 'depth heatmap — raw · gpu+f32', fps 60, Stop enabled) and Stop returned it to the stopped state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Concept page lede restates and delivers on the framing used in the feature index card.

edge_cases.rationale: The probe panel and the explicit WebXR-absent simulation path surface unsupported branches in the UI, not just the happy path (carried from the 2026-06-01 critique).

references.rationale: Page cites chromestatus.com/feature/5074096916004864 (the feature's verified id) and the spec.

conformance.rationale: Only the feature-level interface-existence suite covers this page; nothing asserts the getDepthInformation contract the concept teaches (existing suites are immutable; not touched).

runtime_evidence.rationale: This pass (headless Chromium 141 via CDP, desktop 1280x1600 + mobile 360x740 DPR3): corrected prose served, start/stop cycle driven with label/fps/button-state changes observed, console clean (environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure only), no horizontal overflow on either class — but the selectors and smoothing toggle were not all driven this pass.

telemetry_health.rationale: No showcaseTelemetry asserts anywhere on the page.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; toggle and control buttons pair background with color (rules 5 and 6).

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/selects with visible labels, but the heatmap canvas is the primary output with only a short overlay label, the smoothing toggle lacks aria-pressed, and changing stats have no live-region equivalent; the accessibility tree was not inspected this pass.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 1280x1600 or 360x740 DPR3 (CDP emulation, screenshots taken), but touch operation of every control and the full parity checklist were not exercised this pass.

openQuestions.title: Add telemetry and non-visual output for the heatmap state
openQuestions.detail: Record a showcaseTelemetry assert after Start succeeds (and the simulation branch separately), give the smoothing toggle aria-pressed semantics, and mirror the running/stopped state and fps through text or a polite live region so the canvas is not the only carrier of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible continuously updating level meter role meter text equivalent
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Continuously-updating visual output should have a text/semantic equivalent rather than being canvas-only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception for this pass: the only change made here was a one-line factual prose fix (depthType -> depthTypeRequest sequence), so no UI restructuring was done; the canvas-only-output gap is recorded as an open question instead.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP verification limited to the corrected prose, the start/stop interaction, console, and overflow checks.

summary: Touched this pass only for a factual API-surface correction in the performance-tips prose: the scalar depthType wording is now the spec's depthTypeRequest: ["smooth"] sequence, matching the immersive-web depth-sensing draft IDL verified today. The page — probe panel, labelled simulation, working start/stop heatmap — was smoke-verified via CDP (start/stop cycle drove label, fps, and button states; clean console; no overflow on desktop or mobile) but not exhaustively re-reviewed; telemetry and non-visual heatmap state remain the known gaps.
